description: Difficulty + popularity for a specific keyword (or up to 25 in bulk). Use this when you already know which keywords you care about — costs 1 credit per keyword. Works without an API key for up to 5 keywords/day (free tier, per IP); an API key removes that cap. Use sonar_keyword_search instead when you want related keyword ideas alongside metrics. A keyword the API cannot compute right away comes back as `pending` (queued on the scrape fleet, not charged) — this tool already waits and re-checks briefly; if it is still pending, call again after `retry_after_seconds`.

keyword.description: Single keyword to fetch metrics for. Use this OR `keywords`, not both.

keywords.description: Bulk list of keywords to fetch metrics for (max 25). Use this OR `keyword`, not both. 1 credit per keyword.

store.description: App store. "ios" for Apple App Store, "android" for Google Play.

name: sonar_keyword_metrics
title: Keyword Metrics
